test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following provisions of the Indian constitution is borrowed from the constitution of Canada?

options.text: Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme court

solution:
The correct answer is __Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme court__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Canadian Constitution: 

 
 
• Advisory Jurisdiction of Supreme Court.
 
• A federal system with a strong center.
 
• Residual powers vest at the center.
 
• Appointment of State Governors.​
